caption: The drawing depicts a single object centered on a plain background with a thin rectangular border. The object has a pear-shaped body with a pointed, tiered spout at the top resembling a nozzle, colored in shades of brown, yellow, and gold. The main body of the object is tan or light brown, bordered in a darker brown or black outline. Intricate floral patterns in red, pink, green, and brown are present on the broad surface of the main body. Two wooden-looking handles protrude downward and outward from the bottom of the object, one slightly larger and longer than the other. The surface texture and shading suggest the object is crafted from wood or leather, with metallic details on the nozzle. There are no other items or elements in the composition. The background remains an off-white or light beige tone, providing contrast to the colored and detailed central object.
title: Bellows
